summary: Aeb is a northern Thai banana-leaf parcel grilled over heat, usually filled with seasoned fish or pork and herbs. For a fish version, look for aeb pla; Huen Phen in Chiang Mai’s Old City has served it, though December 2026 availability is unconfirmed.
whyGo: The leaf parcel traps the aroma of herbs and keeps the filling moist; the fish version can be more herb-forward and less custardy than central Thai hor mok.
It is a focused way to try a Lanna preparation alongside better-known northern dishes.
bestFor: Travelers curious about northern Thai cooking and grilled leaf-wrapped foods.
Fish eaters who want a small shared plate rather than a full meal.
skipIf: You avoid fish, pork, curry paste, or dishes cooked on shared grills.
You need confirmed vegetarian, vegan, allergen-safe, or gluten-free preparation; these details are not published.
duration: Allow about 45–75 minutes for a meal at Huen Phen; this is a planning estimate, not a service-time guarantee.
cost: Plan around THB 50–160 per dish at Huen Phen using a June 2026 Chiang Mai food guide. An older Huen Phen visit listed aeb pla at THB 50; treat that as historical, not a current quote. Add rice or other dishes as desired.
hours: A 2026 food guide lists Huen Phen at about 08:30–16:00 and 17:00–22:00. Hours and service may change; check the restaurant on the day, and avoid the afternoon break.
bestTime: Lunch or early dinner gives the best chance to find a dish that may be made in limited batches. Ask before traveling specifically for aeb.
gettingThere: Huen Phen is on Ratchamanka Road in the Old City, just south of Wat Chedi Luang. Walk from nearby Old City sights or take a red songthaew and agree the fare with the driver before setting off. A ride-hailing car is another practical option; allow for city traffic.
booking: No booking information for aeb is published. For an ordinary meal, walk in; call Huen Phen at +66 53 814 548 (number listed by the restaurant review) to ask whether aeb pla is available that day.
accessibility: Step-free access, accessible toilets, table spacing, and seating details are not confirmed in the sources. Contact the restaurant ahead if these affect your visit; the old-house dining layout may require checking in person.
practicalTips: Ask for “aeb pla” (แอ๊บปลา) for fish, or simply “aeb” if you are open to the filling the kitchen has that day; menus and fillings vary.
Ask staff to confirm the filling and ingredients. Aeb may contain fish or pork, curry paste, fish sauce, and other seasonings; disclose allergies clearly.
Aeb pla is grilled inside banana leaf, but the filling itself is cooked and the leaf is removed for eating. Confirm cooking method if avoiding shared equipment or cross-contact.
Huen Phen serves a broad northern menu, so pair the parcel with rice and another dish if it is offered as a small portion.
decemberNotes: December is in Chiang Mai’s popular cool-season travel period, so Old City restaurants can be busy, especially at dinner. No December 2026 special service or aeb availability is published. Confirm opening hours and ask about the dish on the same day; do not rely on an old menu price.
uncertainties: Whether Huen Phen will serve aeb pla in December 2026, and its current price and portion size, are unverified.
Exact current hours, accessibility arrangements, and allergen or cross-contact procedures require confirmation with the restaurant.
The Commons photograph is aeb pla noi made with small freshwater fish and brine shrimp; it is a representative dish image, not a photo of Huen Phen’s version.
